ai.overview: The San Jose Sharks put their lineal championship belt on the line for the first time in this reign when they host the Calgary Flames on November 17th. San Jose captured the belt in their most recent victory and will look to defend it at home against a Calgary side that has held the belt 68 times previously in franchise history. This matchup features two teams below .500 battling for lineal bragging rights.
key_matchups: San Jose riding momentum with 2 straight wins including a 4–2 victory over Nashville, while Calgary limps in after a devastating 1–6 loss at Anaheim
Calgary holds a 2-0-1 edge in the last 3 meetings, including a 2-1 victory on November 2nd
Both teams struggling this season at 10-13 and 9-12 respectively, making this belt defense wide open
ai.betting_angles: The Elo model sees this as a toss-up, which aligns with two evenly-matched struggling teams. San Jose has won their last 2 games and holds home ice, while Calgary was crushed 1–6 in their most recent outing. The Flames have owned the recent head-to-head series with wins in 3 of the last 4 meetings, though the all-time series shows Calgary ahead 89-71-8.
ai.prediction_writeup: San Jose gets the nod in what should be a tight contest between two below-.500 clubs. The Sharks have won their last 2 games and will have the home crowd behind them in their first belt defense. Calgary's brutal 1–6 loss at Anaheim suggests they may still be reeling, despite their recent success against San Jose. In a toss-up game, momentum and home ice prove decisive for the belt holder.
